preconditions.description: The currency type must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, float) for value in values_list)
preconditions.description: All elements in the values list must be floats.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, str) for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return list must be strings.
The length of the return list must be equal to the length of the input values list.

postconditions.expression: all(result.endswith('$') if to_currency == 'USD' else result.endswith('€') for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each result string must end with '$' if the target currency is 'USD', otherwise it must end with '€'.

postconditions.expression: all(result[:-1].replace(',', '') == str(round(value * (1.1363636 if to_currency == 'USD' else 1 / 1.1363636), 2)) for value, result in zip(values_list, return_value))
postconditions.description: Each result string (excluding the currency symbol) must represent the correctly converted and rounded amount.
